reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true → high spectral entropy (0.9185) indicates near-white-noise; robust_median is preferred over mean for outlier resistance
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false (5 unique per-horizon winners) → per-horizon selection captures differentiated model performance across forecast horizons
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.2632) → soft combiner with shrinkage (0.35) is more robust than hard selection; top_k=4 aligns with recommended_knobs.top_k=4
